summary: Join our expert-led course on tax-deferred retirement accounts and investment strategies. Learn to maximize your savings and achieve your retirement goals!
lede: Tax-deferred retirement accounts include employer-sponsored plans, individual account structures, and defined benefit or defined contribution plans. For professionals who contribute to or manage retirement plans, understanding the differences supports decisions about contributions, employer matching and vesting, investment choices, fees, and withdrawals. The course also covers diversification, comparing fund options, and planning how retirement savings may provide income.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who contribute to or manage retirement plans and need to understand tax and investment choices.
audience: NGO and public sector staff enrolled
Small business owners and self-employed professionals
modules: Contribution Rules, Employer Matching, and Vesting
Diversification and Asset Allocation by Life Stage
Retirement Income Strategies and Decumulation Planning
Fees, Plan Governance, and Provider Evaluation
Retirement Planning Across Sectors and Career Paths
Communicating and Coaching on Retirement Choices
prerequisites: No prior tax or investment experience required, but familiarity with basic financial concepts is recommended.
